recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not add a core Linkage invariant unless a future final PA/PC decision brings Linkage back into core scope or defines the invariant in the external/incubator artifact; handle FHIR-53725 separately if it reaches a final Applied/Published state.
issue_request: FHIR-11467 was a Published FHIR-core Patient Administration issue resolved Not Persuasive with Modification for DSTU2. It asked whether Patient.link remained necessary after the Linkage resource was introduced and requested guidance on when to use Patient.link, Person, and Linkage, including Patient narrative, Linkage narrative, and a recommended Linkage invariant for patient/practitioner/person/relatedperson resources.
initial_application: The historical implementation commit b31c6226eb9411fe9ce4840784e0d098fd33efa4 (Tracker#11467) changed source/patient/patient-notes.xml to add the Patient vs. Person vs. Patient.Link vs. Linkage section and the safety rationale against using Linkage instead of Patient.link. I found no FHIR-11467-tagged commit adding the recommended Linkage invariant.
additional_context: Later Applied issues refined the same boundary: FHIR-48396 added explicit Patient bullets saying Linkage should not be used for linking patients, individuals, or encounters, and FHIR-45033 added matching Linkage boundary guidance. September 2024 PA/PC minutes record the intended Linkage summary and Patient-page reference. A later commit removed Linkage from the active core [resources] list and updated Patient to link to the external/incubator Linkage artifact. FHIR-53725 is a later Triaged issue about remaining Patient Linkage wording after that move and is not final enough to drive this reconciliation.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current active Patient narrative already conveys the seed safety rationale and the later explicit usage guidance, while editing source/linkage or adding a Linkage invariant would target a resource that is not currently active in the core build.

Triaged R6 issue about removing or revising remaining Patient Linkage wording after Linkage moved out of core; not final enough to apply in this run.
